title: Real classroom algebra tiles: simplifying expressions
learning_objective: Students use algebra tiles to connect area/side-length representations to x, y, x², y², xy, positive/negative units, and simplify like terms such as x² + y² + 3x².
common_misconceptions: Confusing solving an equation with simplifying an expression.
Treating tile colour/position as the reason a quantity is positive or negative rather than using the expression/mat convention.
Combining unlike terms such as x and x² or failing to group like terms.
Interpreting physical tile fit without connecting it to variable side lengths and area.
